reference_text: I'd just like to tell you a true story. This is what it's like living in London nowadays. In fact, it's the same everywhere really. What I hate is the hard sell. You know, you get the hard sell, right? I got it the other day. You know when people ring you up and say, you know, do you want to combine the gas with the electric, right? And I was like, oh, that sounds dangerous.
